local function criarTagCustomizada(root, cor, textoNome, ehNPC, idUnica)
    if not ScreenGui:FindFirstChild(idUnica) then
        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Name = idUnica
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        
        if ehNPC then
            billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 50)

        frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        frame.Parent = billboard

        labelCategoria.Name = "LabelCategoria"
        labelCategoria.Size = ehNPC and UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.4, 0) or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.45, 0)
        labelCategoria.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        labelCategoria.Text = ehNPC and "👥 NPC" or "📦 ITEM"
        labelCategoria.TextColor3 = cor
        labelCategoria.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        labelCategoria.TextScaled = true
        labelCategoria.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        labelCategoria.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        labelCategoria.Parent = frame

        labelNome.Name = "LabelNome"

-- FUNÇÃO SEGURO: Checa se o item está acoplado dentro do corpo de algum humanoide
local function pertenceAAlguemVivo(objeto)
    local atual = objeto
    while atual and atual ~= Workspace do
        if atual:IsA("Model") and (atual:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or listaNPCs[atual.Name]) then
            return true
        end
        atual = atual.Parent
    end
    return false
end

    print("💎 Força Bruta V1.8 Ativada! Pesquisador Raro integrado ao ESP.")

                            local nomeLimpo = modeloDono.Name:gsub("BatteryPack_", "Bateria "):gsub("Quest_", ""):gsub("Spawn", "")

                            if tag and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then

                                local txtDist = frameHUD and frameHUD:FindFirstChild("LabelDistancia")
                                if txtDist then txtDist.Text = dist .. " studs" end

                createESP(player)

            local drawings = espDrawings[player]
            local char = player.Character

local function findPlayer(query)
    if not query or query == "" then return nil end
    query = string.lower(query)
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if string.lower(player.Name) == query or string.lower(player.DisplayName) == query then
            return player
        end
    end
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local nameLower = string.lower(player.Name)
        local displayLower = string.lower(player.DisplayName)
        if string.sub(nameLower, 1, #query) == query or string.sub(displayLower, 1, #query) == query then
            return player
        end
    end
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local nameLower = string.lower(player.Name)
        local displayLower = string.lower(player.DisplayName)
        if string.find(nameLower, query, 1, true) or string.find(displayLower, query, 1, true) then
            return player
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

    if not hrp or not hum then return end

    if flying then stopFly() end
    flying = true
    hum.PlatformStand = true

    bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bg.P = 9e4
    bg.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e4, 9e4, 9e4)
    bg.cframe = hrp.CFrame
    bg.Parent = hrp

    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    bv.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e4, 9e4, 9e4)
    bv.Parent = hrp

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying or not char or not hrp.Parent then return end
        local camCF = Camera.CFrame
        local moveDir = Vector3.new()

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDir = moveDir + camCF.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDir = moveDir - camCF.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDir = moveDir - camCF.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDir = moveDir + camCF.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)

        bv.velocity = moveDir * flySpeed
        bg.cframe = camCF

local function __NARootExecutorInfo()
	local name = "Unknown"

local function __NARootNextErrorPath()

local function __NARootReportError(rawError, tracebackText, context, fn, options)
	options = type(options) == "table" and options or {}
	__NARootErrorState.rootCount = (tonumber(__NARootErrorState.rootCount) or 0) + 1
	local logPath, fileIndex = __NARootNextErrorPath()
	local execName, execVersion = __NARootExecutorInfo()

	local clientVersion = "Unknown"
	if type(version) == "function" then
		local ok, value = pcall(version)
		if ok and value ~= nil and tostring(value) ~= "" then clientVersion = tostring(value) end
	end
	local timestamp = tostring(os.time and os.time() or "Unknown")
	if type(os.date) == "function" then
		local ok, value = pcall(os.date, "!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
		if ok and value then timestamp = tostring(value) end
	end
	local placeName = "Unknown"

			platform = tostring(uis:GetPlatform())
		end
	end)
	local errorId = "NAE-ROOT-"..string.format("%06d", tonumber(fileIndex) or tonumber(__NARootErrorState.rootCount) or 1)
	local lines = {
		"[Nameless Admin Root Error Report]";
		"Error ID: "..errorId;
		"Error File: NA_Error#"..tostring(fileIndex or "Unknown")..".txt";
		"Time (UTC): "..timestamp;
		"Context: "..tostring(context or options.context or "Nameless Admin Main Runtime");
		"Severity: "..string.upper(tostring(options.severity or "fatal"));
		"";
		"Runtime";
		"Executor: "..execName;
		"Executor Version: "..execVersion;
		"Roblox Client: "..clientVersion;
		"Platform: "..platform;
		"NA Source: "..__NA_SPLIT_SOURCE_TAG;
		"Coverage: Root NACaller";
		"";
		"Session";
		"Place: "..placeName;
		"PlaceId: "..placeId;
		"GameId: "..gameId;
		"JobId: "..jobId;
		"";
		"Callback";
		"Function: "..fnName;
		"Defined At: "..fnSource..":"..tostring(fnLine);
		"";
		"Error";
		tostring(rawError or "Unknown error");
		"";
		"Traceback";
		tostring(tracebackText or rawError or "Unavailable");
	}
	if type(options.details) == "table" then
		lines[#lines + 1] = ""
		lines[#lines + 1] = "Additional Context"
		for key, value in options.details do
			lines[#lines + 1] = tostring(key)..": "..tostring(value)
		end
	end
	local report = table.concat(lines, "\n")
	local writer = type(writefile) == "function" and writefile or (type(appendfile) == "function" and appendfile or nil)
	local saved = false
	if options.log ~= false and type(writer) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			writer(logPath, report.."\n")
			saved = true
		end)
	end
	if options.warn ~= false and type(warn) == "function" then
		pcall(warn, report..(saved and ("\nSaved: "..logPath) or ""))
	end
	return report, saved and logPath or nil, errorId
end

local function __NARootNACaller(fnOrOptions, ...)
	local options = {}
	local fn
	local args
	if type(fnOrOptions) == "table" and type(select(1, ...)) == "function" then
		for key, value in fnOrOptions do options[key] = value end
		fn = select(1, ...)
		args = table.pack(select(2, ...))
	else
		fn = fnOrOptions
		args = table.pack(...)
	end
	if type(fn) ~= "function" then
		local message = "NACaller expected a function, got "..type(fn)
		__NARootReportError(message, message, options.context or "NACaller bootstrap", nil, options)
		return false, message
	end
	local rawError
	local results = table.pack(xpcall(function()
		return fn(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
	end, function(message)
		rawError = tostring(message or "Unknown error")
		if type(debug) == "table" and type(debug.traceback) == "function" then
			local ok, trace = pcall(debug.traceback, rawError, 2)
			if ok and type(trace) == "string" and trace ~= "" then return trace end
		end
		return rawError
	end))
	if not results[1] then
		local trace = tostring(results[2] or rawError or "Unknown error")
		__NARootReportError(rawError or trace, trace, options.context or "Nameless Admin Main Runtime", fn, options)
		if options.rethrow == true then error(trace, 0) end
	end
	return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_PART_VALID(source, meta, name)
	if type(source) ~= "string" or source == "" then return false end

	if checks == nil then return true end
	local check = type(checks) == "table" and checks[name] or nil
	if type(check) ~= "table" or #source ~= check[1] or type(check[2]) ~= "number" then return false end
	local a, b = 1, 0
	local nextYield = os.clock() + 0.004
	for start = 1, #source, 4096 do
		for index = start, math.min(start + 4095, #source) do
			a += string.byte(source, index)

		end
		a %= 65521
		b %= 65521
		if start + 4095 < #source and os.clock() >= nextYield then
			__NA_SPLIT_YIELD()
			nextYield = os.clock() + 0.004
		end
	end
	return b * 65536 + a == check[2]
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_CLEAR_LEGACY()
	if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(delfolder) ~= "function" then return 0 end

		if depth > 16 then return end
		local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, path)
		if not ok or not exists then return end
		if type(listfiles) == "function" then
			local listed, items = pcall(listfiles, path)
			if listed and type(items) == "table" then
				for _, entry in items do
					local name = tostring(entry):gsub("\\", "/"):gsub("^%./", ""):gsub("/+$", "")
					if name:sub(1, #root + 1) == root.."/"
						and not name:find("/../", 1, true) and name:sub(-3) ~= "/.." then
						local valid, isDir = pcall(isfolder, name)
						if valid and isDir then
							clean(root, name, depth + 1)
						elseif type(delfile) == "function" then
							pcall(delfile, name)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		pcall(delfolder, path)

	local removed = 0
	for _, root in { "NA-split", "Nameless-Admin/NA-split", "Nameless Admin/NA-split" } do
		local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, root)
		if ok and exists then
			clean(root, root, 0)

			if checked and not remains then removed += 1 end
		end
	end
	return removed
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_PREPARE(source, name)
	local rows = __NA_SPLIT_DEFER and __NA_SPLIT_DEFER[name]

	local out, pos = {}, 1
	for _, row in rows do

		local first, last, cut, line, prefix = table.unpack(row, 1, 5)
		if type(first) ~= "number" or type(last) ~= "number" or type(cut) ~= "number"
			or type(line) ~= "number" or type(prefix) ~= "string" or first < pos or last < first or last > #source

		out[#out + 1] = source:sub(pos, first - 1)
		local label = "NA-split/common/"..name..":"..tostring(line)
		out[#out + 1] = prefix.."__NA_SPLIT_LAZY("..string.format("%q, %d, %d, %d, %q", name, first, last, cut, label)..")"
		pos = last + 1

	return table.concat(out)

				local boot = type(env) == "table" and rawget(env, "_na_boot")
				env = type(boot) == "table" and boot.runtimeEnv or env
				local chunk = __NA_SPLIT_LOAD_PART("return "..body, label, env)
				local value = chunk()
				if type(value) ~= "function" then error("Invalid deferred function: "..label, 0) end
				return value
			end)
			busy = nil
			if not ok then error(result, 0) end
			fn = result
		end
		return fn(...)
	end
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_QUEUE_REFRESH(key, url, fetch)
	if type(fetch) == "function" then
		__NA_MODULE_REFRESH[key] = {url = url, fetch = fetch}
	end
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_REFRESH_MODULES()
	if not __NA_SPLIT_LIMITED or not __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META or type(task.spawn) ~= "function" then return end
	task.spawn(function()
		for key, record in __NA_MODULE_REFRESH do
			if not __NA_SPLIT_OWNS() then break end
			local ok, source = pcall(record.fetch)
			if ok and type(source) == "string" and __NA_SPLIT_OWNS() then
				pcall(__NA_SPLIT_SAVE_MODULE, key, record.url, source)
			end
			__NA_MODULE_REFRESH[key] = nil
			task.wait()
		end
		table.clear(__NA_MODULE_REFRESH)
	end)
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_RUN()
	__NA_SPLIT_READ_DEFER()
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.state = __NA_GLOBAL_STATE
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.privateRoot = __NA_GLOBAL_ENV
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.privateRegistry = __NA_SPLIT_REG
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.cacheRoot = __NA_SPLIT_CACHE_ROOT
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.offline = __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META == nil
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.fastStart = __NA_SPLIT_LIMITED
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.moduleRefresh = __NA_SPLIT_QUEUE_REFRESH
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.moduleRead = __NA_SPLIT_READ_MODULE
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.moduleWrite = __NA_SPLIT_SAVE_MODULE
	local environment = setmetatable({
		__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG = __NA_SPLIT_CONFIG;
		__NA_SPLIT_LAZY = __NA_SPLIT_LAZY;
		NACaller = __NARootNACaller;
		__NARootHost = __NARootHost;
		__NARootPreviousNACaller = __NARootPreviousNACaller;
		__NARootErrorState = __NARootErrorState;
		__NARootExecutorInfo = __NARootExecutorInfo;
		__NARootDebugInfo = __NARootDebugInfo;
		__NARootNextErrorPath = __NARootNextErrorPath;
		__NARootReportError = __NARootReportError;
		__NARootNACaller = __NARootNACaller;
	}, {
		__index = function(target, key)
			local boot = rawget(target, "_na_boot")
			local runtime = type(boot) == "table" and boot.runtimeEnv
			if type(runtime) == "table" then
				local value = rawget(runtime, key)
				if value ~= nil then
					return value
				end
			end
			return __NARootHost[key]
		end;
		__newindex = function(target, key, value)
			local boot = rawget(target, "_na_boot")
			local runtime = type(boot) == "table" and boot.runtimeEnv
			if type(runtime) == "table" and key ~= "_na_boot" and key ~= "_na_env" and key ~= "_na_shared" then
				rawset(runtime, key, value)
			else
				rawset(target, key, value)
			end
		end;
	})
	__NA_SPLIT_ENV = environment
	for index = 1, __NA_SPLIT_COUNT do
		if not __NA_SPLIT_OWNS() then
			error("Nameless Admin loading was cancelled", 0)
		end
		local partName = string.format("part-%03d.lua", index)
		__NA_GLOBAL_STATE.details.stage = partName
		__NA_GLOBAL_STATE.details.fingerprint = __NA_SPLIT_PART_FINGERPRINT(__NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META or __NA_SPLIT_LOCAL_META, partName)
		__NA_SPLIT_SET_STAGE(partName)
		local source = __NA_SPLIT_READ_PART(partName)
		if not __NA_SPLIT_OWNS() then error("Nameless Admin loading was cancelled", 0) end
		local chunk = __NA_SPLIT_LOAD_PART(__NA_SPLIT_PREPARE(source, partName), "NA-split/common/"..partName, environment)
		local okRun, runError = xpcall(chunk, __NA_SPLIT_FORMAT_ERROR)
		chunk = nil
		source = nil
		if not okRun then
			error(__NA_SPLIT_FORMAT_ERROR(runError), 0)
		end
		if index == 1 then
			if runError == "__NA_SPLIT_DUPLICATE" then
				__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.duplicate = true
				__NA_SPLIT_ENV = nil
				return
			end
			local boot = rawget(environment, "_na_boot")
			if type(boot) ~= "table" or type(boot.runtimeEnv) ~= "table" then
				error("Nameless Admin split bootstrap did not initialize", 0)
			end
			local migrated = {}
			for key, value in environment do
				if key ~= "__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG" and key ~= "NACaller" and key ~= "_na_boot" and key ~= "_na_env" and key ~= "_na_shared" then
					migrated[key] = value
				end
			end
			for key, value in migrated do
				rawset(boot.runtimeEnv, key, value)
				rawset(environment, key, nil)
			end
			environment = boot.runtimeEnv
			__NA_SPLIT_ENV = environment
		end
		__NA_SPLIT_CACHE_PART(partName)
		__NA_SPLIT_YIELD()
	end
	if not __NA_SPLIT_OWNS() then

	end
	__NA_SPLIT_SET_STAGE("cache")

	local saved = __NA_SPLIT_LOAD_MANIFEST(__NA_SPLIT_READ_LOCAL(__NA_SPLIT_CACHE_ROOT, "manifest.lua"), __NA_SPLIT_CACHE_ROOT.."manifest.lua")
	local expected = __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META or __NA_SPLIT_LOCAL_META
	if __NA_SPLIT_CACHE_OK and saved and expected and saved.version == expected.version then
		pcall(__NA_SPLIT_CLEAR_LEGACY)
	end
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_ABORT()
	if not __NA_SPLIT_OWNS() then return end
	local environment = __NA_SPLIT_ENV
	if type(environment) ~= "table" then return end
	local boot = rawget(environment, "_na_boot")
	if type(boot) == "table" and type(boot.splitConfig) == "table" and boot.splitConfig.state ~= __NA_GLOBAL_STATE then return end
	local runtime = type(boot) == "table" and boot.runtimeEnv or environment
	local manage = rawget(runtime, "NAmanage")
	local unload = type(manage) == "table" and rawget(manage, "Unload")
	if type(unload) == "function" then
		local ok, done = pcall(unload, { silent = true })
		if ok and done ~= false then return end
	end
	if type(manage) == "table" and type(manage._runtimeState) == "table" then
		manage._runtimeState.unloading = true
		manage._runtimeState.runToken = nil
	end
	local seen = {}
	local current = coroutine.running()
	local function cancel(thread)
		if type(manage) == "table" and type(manage.CancelRuntimeTask) == "function" then
			pcall(manage.CancelRuntimeTask, thread)
		elseif type(task) == "table" then
			pcall(task.cancel, thread)
		end
	end
	local function clean(value)
		if type(value) ~= "table" or seen[value] then return end
		if type(boot) == "table" and (value == boot or value == boot.hostEnv
			or value == boot.privateRegistry or value == boot.privateRoot or value == runtime) then return end
		seen[value] = true
		if rawget(value, "Connected") ~= nil and type(rawget(value, "Disconnect")) == "function" then
			pcall(rawget(value, "Disconnect"), value)
		end
		for key, child in next, value do
			if typeof(child) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
				pcall(function() child:Disconnect() end)
			elseif type(child) == "thread" and child ~= current and coroutine.status(child) ~= "dead" and type(task) == "table" then
				cancel(child)
			elseif type(child) == "table" then
				clean(child)
			end
			if type(key) == "thread" and key ~= current and coroutine.status(key) ~= "dead" and type(task) == "table" then cancel(key) end
		end
	end
	for _, name in { "NAmanage", "NAStuff", "NAjobs", "NAgui", "NAUIMANAGER", "NAindex", "NAAssetsLoading" } do clean(rawget(runtime, name)) end
	local stuff = rawget(runtime, "NAStuff")
	if type(stuff) == "table" and typeof(stuff.NASCREENGUI) == "Instance" then
		pcall(function() stuff.NASCREENGUI:Destroy() end)
	end
	local assets = rawget(runtime, "NAAssetsLoading")
	if type(assets) == "table" and typeof(assets.ui) == "Instance" then
		pcall(function() assets.ui:Destroy() end)
	end
	if type(boot) == "table" and type(boot.privateRoot) == "table" then
		local root = boot.privateRoot
		local owned = rawget(runtime, "_na_env")
		local ownsRoot = type(owned) == "table" and root.testing == owned
		local protector = rawget(runtime, "__NAUIProtector")
		if type(protector) ~= "table" and ownsRoot then protector = root.uiProtector end
		if type(protector) == "table" and (ownsRoot or root.uiProtector ~= protector) then
			if type(protector.destroy) == "function" then pcall(protector.destroy) end
			if root.uiProtector == protector then root.uiProtector = nil end
		end
		if ownsRoot then
			root.testing = nil
			root.naRuns = nil
		end
	end
end

__NA_GLOBAL_STATE.details = {
	stage = "manifest";
	session = tostring(game.PlaceId).."_"..tostring(game.JobId);
	build = (__NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META and __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META.version) or (__NA_SPLIT_LOCAL_META and __NA_SPLIT_LOCAL_META.version) or "unknown";
}

local __NARootResult = table.pack(__NARootNACaller({
	context = "Nameless Admin Main Runtime";
	details = __NA_GLOBAL_STATE.details;
	severity = "fatal";
	warn = true;
	log = true;
}, __NA_SPLIT_RUN))

if not __NARootResult[1] then pcall(__NA_SPLIT_ABORT) end

if (not __NARootResult[1] or __NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.duplicate) and type(__NARootHost) == "table"
	and rawget(__NARootHost, "NACaller") == __NARootNACaller then
	pcall(function()
		if __NARootPreviousNACaller ~= nil then
			rawset(__NARootHost, "NACaller", __NARootPreviousNACaller)
		else
			rawset(__NARootHost, "NACaller", nil)
		end
	end)
end

if __NARootResult[1] then
	__NA_SPLIT_RELEASE(not __NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.duplicate)
	if not __NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.duplicate then __NA_SPLIT_REFRESH_MODULES() end
	return table.unpack(__NARootResult, 2, __NARootResult.n)
end

__NA_SPLIT_RELEASE(false)

local Players            = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService         = game:GetService("RunService")

local TweenService       = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris             = game:GetService("Debris")
local Workspace          = game:GetService("Workspace")

local function getService(name)
    local service = game:GetService(name)
    if cloneref then
        local ok, res = pcall(cloneref, service)
        if ok and res then return res end
    end
    return service
end

local CoreGui     = getService("CoreGui")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse       = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
local Camera      = Workspace.CurrentCamera

local CFG = {
    SilentEnabled   = true,
    TargetPart      = "Head",
    HitChance       = 100,
    MaxDistance      = 2500,

    WallbangEnabled = true,
    WallCheck       = false,

    FOVEnabled      = true,
    FOVVisible      = true,
    FOVRadius       = 200,

    ESPEnabled      = true,

    IndicatorEnabled = true,
}

local CurrentTarget = nil
local FOVCircle     = nil

if Drawing and Drawing.new then
    FOVCircle              = Drawing.new("Circle")
    FOVCircle.Visible      = CFG.FOVVisible
    FOVCircle.Radius       = CFG.FOVRadius
    FOVCircle.Color        = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 80)
    FOVCircle.Thickness    = 1.5
    FOVCircle.Filled       = false
    FOVCircle.Transparency = 0.7
    FOVCircle.NumSides     = 64
end

local function IsEnemy(character)
    if not character or character == LocalPlayer.Character then return false end
    local outline = character:FindFirstChild("TR_EnemyOutline")
        or character:FindFirstChild("TR_EnemyOutline", true)
    return outline ~= nil
end

local function IsVisible(targetPart, character)
    if CFG.WallbangEnabled then return true end
    if not CFG.WallCheck then return true end

    local origin    = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = targetPart.Position - origin

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    local ignore = { LocalPlayer.Character, character, Camera }
    local fxF = Workspace:FindFirstChild("FX")
    if fxF then table.insert(ignore, fxF) end
    local prF = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Projectiles")
    if prF then table.insert(ignore, prF) end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore

    return Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params) == nil
end

local function ResolvePartName()
    if CFG.TargetPart == "Random" then
        local opts = {"Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "UpperTorso"}
        return opts[math.random(1, #opts)]
    end
    return CFG.TargetPart
end

local function GetClosestTarget()
    local best     = nil
    local bestDist = CFG.FOVRadius
    local mPos     = Vector2.new(Mouse.X, Mouse.Y)
    local myRoot   = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end

    local candidates = {}

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            table.insert(candidates, {char = p.Character, player = p})
        end
    end

    for _, m in pairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if m:IsA("Model") and m ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
            if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) then
                if m:FindFirstChild("TR_EnemyOutline") or m:FindFirstChild("TR_EnemyOutline", true) then
                    table.insert(candidates, {char = m, player = nil})
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, c in pairs(candidates) do
        local char = c.char
        if IsEnemy(char) then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local partName = ResolvePartName()
                local part = char:FindFirstChild(partName)
                    or char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local dist3D = (part.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist3D <= CFG.MaxDistance then
                        local sPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                        if onScreen then
                            local d2 = (Vector2.new(sPos.X, sPos.Y) - mPos).Magnitude
                            if d2 < bestDist and IsVisible(part, char) then
                                bestDist = d2
                                best = {
                                    Player    = c.player,
                                    Character = char,
                                    Part      = part,
                                    PartName  = partName,
                                    ScreenPos = sPos,
                                    Distance  = math.floor(dist3D),
                                }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return best
end

local function RollHit()
    return math.random(1, 100) <= CFG.HitChance
end

local WeaponAction = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("WeaponAction")

if hookmetamethod or getrawmetatable then
    local oldNamecall
    oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        local args   = {...}

        if method == "FireServer" and self == WeaponAction then
            if CFG.SilentEnabled and CurrentTarget and RollHit() then
                local action = args[1]
                if action == "Shoot" and type(args[2]) == "table" then
                    local data = args[2]
                    if typeof(data.origin) == "Vector3" and typeof(data.dir) == "Vector3" then
                        local tPos   = CurrentTarget.Part.Position
                        data.dir     = (tPos - data.origin).Unit
                        args[2]      = data
                        return oldNamecall(self, unpack(args))
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return oldNamecall(self, ...)
    end))
end

if not hookmetamethod and not getrawmetatable then
    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
        if gpe then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            if CFG.SilentEnabled and CurrentTarget and RollHit() then
                local orig  = Camera.CFrame
                Camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(orig.Position, CurrentTarget.Part.Position)
                task.defer(function() Camera.CFrame = orig end)
            end
        end
    end)
end

indicatorGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
pcall(function() indicatorGui.Parent = CoreGui end)

indStroke.Transparency = 0.3
indStroke.Parent = indicatorFrame

local indName = Instance.new("TextLabel")
indName.Name = "NameLabel"
indName.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
indName.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 4)
indName.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 22)

indName.TextSize = 15

indName.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
indName.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
indName.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
indName.Text = ""
indName.Parent = indicatorFrame

local indInfo = Instance.new("TextLabel")

indInfo.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)

indInfo.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 22)
indInfo.BackgroundTransparency = 1

indInfo.TextSize = 13

indDot.BorderSizePixel = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    CurrentTarget = GetClosestTarget()

    if FOVCircle then
        FOVCircle.Position = Vector2.new(Mouse.X, Mouse.Y + 36)
        FOVCircle.Radius   = CFG.FOVRadius
        FOVCircle.Visible  = CFG.FOVEnabled and CFG.FOVVisible
    end

    if CFG.IndicatorEnabled and CurrentTarget then
        local name = CurrentTarget.Player
            and CurrentTarget.Player.Name
            or  CurrentTarget.Character.Name
        indName.Text = "» " .. name
        indInfo.Text = "   " .. CurrentTarget.PartName .. "  |  " .. tostring(CurrentTarget.Distance) .. " studs"
        indicatorFrame.Visible = true
        indDot.Visible = true

        if CFG.WallbangEnabled and CFG.WallCheck then
            indStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 40)
        else
            indStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
        end
    else
        indicatorFrame.Visible = false
        indDot.Visible = false

end)

local function CreateESP(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    local function Apply(character)
        if not character then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            local head = character:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
            local hum  = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
            if not head or not hum then return end

            local waited = 0
            while waited < 10 do
                if character:FindFirstChild("TR_EnemyOutline") or character:FindFirstChild("TR_EnemyOutline", true) then break end
                task.wait(0.5)
                waited += 0.5
            end
            if not (character:FindFirstChild("TR_EnemyOutline") or character:FindFirstChild("TR_EnemyOutline", true)) then return end

--// SERVICES
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

--// CHILL MUSIC PLAYLIST (Roblox Sound IDs)
local chillPlaylist = {
    "rbxassetid://1837879082",  -- Chill Lofi 1
    "rbxassetid://1839841807",  -- Chill Lofi 2
    "rbxassetid://9043887091",  -- Ambient Chill
    "rbxassetid://9042539129",  -- Relaxing Beats
    "rbxassetid://1845341258",  -- Smooth Vibe
    "rbxassetid://1848354536"   -- Soft Aesthetic
}

-- Create a dedicated Sound instance
local musicSound = Instance.new("Sound")
musicSound.Name = "BackgroundChillMusic"
musicSound.Volume = 0.5
musicSound.Looped = false
musicSound.Parent = SoundService

local remainingPlaylist = {}

-- Function to shuffle table randomly (Fisher-Yates Shuffle)
local function shufflePlaylist()
    remainingPlaylist = {}
    for _, soundId in ipairs(chillPlaylist) do
        table.insert(remainingPlaylist, soundId)
    end
    
    for i = #remainingPlaylist, 2, -1 do
        local j = math.random(i)
        remainingPlaylist[i], remainingPlaylist[j] = remainingPlaylist[j], remainingPlaylist[i]
    end
    print("[Music Player] Playlist shuffled. " .. tostring(#remainingPlaylist) .. " tracks loaded.")
end

-- Function to play next unique song
local function playNextSong()
    -- Refill and shuffle if playlist is empty or all tracks played
    if #remainingPlaylist == 0 then
        shufflePlaylist()
    end
    
    -- Pick the top track and remove it from the pool to prevent repeats
    local nextTrack = table.remove(remainingPlaylist, 1)
    
    musicSound.SoundId = nextTrack
    musicSound:Play()
    print("[Music Player] Now playing: " .. nextTrack)
end

-- Play next track automatically when the current one ends
musicSound.Ended:Connect(playNextSong)

-- Start the music player
playNextSong()

scripts.script:
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- ULTIMATE ENVIRONMENTAL SYSTEM v6.3 
-- (SHADERS + MOTION BLUR + FIREFLIES + DUST)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

-- 1. ОЧИСТКА (Удаляем всё старое, включая лужи из прошлой версии)
for _, obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
    if obj.Name:match("Shader_") then obj:Destroy() end
end
local oldFX = Workspace:FindFirstChild("EnvironmentFX")
if oldFX then oldFX:Destroy() end
local oldPuddles = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PuddleFolder")
if oldPuddles then oldPuddles:Destroy() end
local oldGrass = Workspace:FindFirstChild("InteractiveGrass")
if oldGrass then oldGrass:Destroy() end

local FXFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
FXFolder.Name = "EnvironmentFX"
FXFolder.Parent = Workspace

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 2. УБИЙЦА РАЗМЫТИЯ (Не трогает Motion Blur)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.5)
        for _, obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:IsA("BlurEffect") and obj.Name ~= "Shader_MotionBlur" then 
                obj.Size = 0
            elseif obj:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then
                obj.FarIntensity = 0; obj.NearIntensity = 0; obj.FocusDistance = 1000
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 3. СОЗДАНИЕ ЭФФЕКТОВ
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local CC = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect"); CC.Name = "Shader_CC"; CC.Parent = Lighting
local Bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect"); Bloom.Name = "Shader_Bloom"; Bloom.Parent = Lighting
local SunRays = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect"); SunRays.Name = "Shader_SunRays"; SunRays.Parent = Lighting
local Atmos = Instance.new("Atmosphere"); Atmos.Name = "Shader_Atmosphere"; Atmos.Parent = Lighting

local MotionBlur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
MotionBlur.Name = "Shader_MotionBlur"
MotionBlur.Size = 0 
MotionBlur.Parent = Lighting

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 4. ПРОФИЛИ ПОГОДЫ
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local NightProfile = {
    CC = {Brightness = 0.15, Contrast = 0.3, Saturation = -0.4, TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 255)},
    Bloom = {Intensity = 2, Size = 24, Threshold = 0.8},
    SunRays = {Intensity = 0.0, Spread = 0.1},
    Atmos = {Density = 0.2, Offset = 0.1, Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 60), Decay = Color3.fromRGB(10, 15, 30), Glare = 0, Haze = 0.5}, 
    LightingProps = {
        Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(80, 90, 130),        
        OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(90, 100, 140), 
        Brightness = 2.5,                              
        ShadowSoftness = 0.5
    },
    FOV = 65 
}

local DayProfile = {
    CC = {Brightness = 0.2, Contrast = 0.2, Saturation = 0.5, TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 150)}, 
    Bloom = {Intensity = 2, Size = 30, Threshold = 1}, 
    SunRays = {Intensity = 0.3, Spread = 0.5},
    Atmos = {Density = 0.25, Offset = 0.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100), Decay = Color3.fromRGB(200, 150, 50), Glare = 0.5, Haze = 2}, 
    LightingProps = {
        Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(120, 100, 80),
        OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 150, 120),
        Brightness = 3.5,
        ShadowSoftness = 0.1
    },
    FOV = 80 
}

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 5. ЛОГИКА ПЕРЕХОДА
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local isNight = false
local currentState = "None"

local function ApplyProfile(profile, transitionTime)
    local tInfo = TweenInfo.new(transitionTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
    TweenService:Create(CC, tInfo, profile.CC):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Bloom, tInfo, profile.Bloom):Play()
    TweenService:Create(SunRays, tInfo, profile.SunRays):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Atmos, tInfo, profile.Atmos):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Lighting, tInfo, profile.LightingProps):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Camera, tInfo, {FieldOfView = profile.FOV}):Play()
end

local initialTime = Lighting.ClockTime
if initialTime >= 18 or initialTime < 6 then
    isNight = true; currentState = "Night"; ApplyProfile(NightProfile, 0)
else
    isNight = false; currentState = "Day"; ApplyProfile(DayProfile, 0)
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 6. ЖУКИ И ПЫЛЬ
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function SpawnFirefly()
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Name = "Firefly"
    part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.Parent = FXFolder

    local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
    light.Color = part.Color
    light.Range = 12
    light.Brightness = 4 
    light.Shadows = true
    light.Parent = part

    local rootPart = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local basePos = rootPart and rootPart.Position or Camera.CFrame.Position
    part.Position = basePos + Vector3.new(math.random(-30, 30), math.random(-5, 10), math.random(-30, 30))

    local startTime = tick()
    local basePosition = part.Position
    
    local connection
    connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not part.Parent then connection:Disconnect() return end
        if rootPart then
            local dist = (part.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < 10 then
                local dir = (part.Position - rootPart.Position).Unit
                basePosition = basePosition + dir * 2
            end
        end
        local timePassed = tick() - startTime
        local xOff = math.sin(timePassed * 2) * 5
        local yOff = math.cos(timePassed * 3) * 2 + math.sin(timePassed * 1) * 1
        local zOff = math.cos(timePassed * 2) * 5
        part.CFrame = CFrame.new(basePosition + Vector3.new(xOff, yOff, zOff))
    end)

    task.delay(math.random(15, 25), function()
        connection:Disconnect()
        if part and part.Parent then
            TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(2), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
            task.wait(2)
            part:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

local function SpawnDust()
    local rootPart = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then return end

    local spawnPos = rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-40, 40), math.random(30, 50), math.random(-40, 40))
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {FXFolder, LocalPlayer.Character}
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local rayResult = Workspace:Raycast(spawnPos, Vector3.new(0, -100, 0), raycastParams)
    
    if rayResult then
        local dust = Instance.new("Part")
        dust.Name = "Dust"
        dust.Size = Vector3.new(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)
        dust.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        dust.Material = Enum.Material.Neon 
        dust.Anchored = true
        dust.CanCollide = false
        dust.Transparency = 0.5
        dust.CFrame = CFrame.new(spawnPos)
        dust.Parent = FXFolder

        local fallDistance = (spawnPos - rayResult.Position).Magnitude
        local fallTween = TweenService:Create(dust, TweenInfo.new(fallDistance / 15, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
            CFrame = CFrame.new(rayResult.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0))
        })
        fallTween:Play()

        fallTween.Completed:Connect(function()
            if dust and dust.Parent then
                local sparkles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                sparkles.Texture = "rbxassetid://241629851"
                sparkles.Rate = 30 
                sparkles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1)
                sparkles.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
                sparkles.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
                sparkles.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.3)
                sparkles.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(200, 255, 200))
                sparkles.LightEmission = 1
                sparkles.Parent = dust
                
                task.wait(5)
                if dust and dust.Parent then
                    sparkles.Rate = 0 
                    TweenService:Create(dust, TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
                    task.wait(2)
                    if dust then dust:Destroy() end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 7. ГЛАВНЫЕ ЦИКЛЫ
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        local currentBugs = 0
        for _, v in ipairs(FXFolder:GetChildren()) do
            if v.Name == "Firefly" then currentBugs = currentBugs + 1 end
        end
        if currentState == "Night" and currentBugs < 15 then SpawnFirefly() end
        if currentState ~= "Night" then
            for _, v in ipairs(FXFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if v.Name == "Firefly" then v:Destroy() end
            end
        end
        task.wait(math.random(1, 2))
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        SpawnDust()
        task.wait(math.random(1, 2))
    end
end)

local timeAccum = 0
local lastCamCFrame = Camera.CFrame
local currentBlur = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    timeAccum = timeAccum + deltaTime
    
    -- MOTION BLUR
    local currentCamCFrame = Camera.CFrame
    local posDelta = (currentCamCFrame.Position - lastCamCFrame.Position).Magnitude
    local rotDelta = (currentCamCFrame.LookVector - lastCamCFrame.LookVector).Magnitude
    local speed = posDelta + (rotDelta * 15)
    lastCamCFrame = currentCamCFrame
    
    local targetBlur = math.clamp(speed * 4, 0, 12)
    currentBlur = currentBlur + (targetBlur - currentBlur) * 0.15
    MotionBlur.Size = currentBlur

    -- Проверка Дня/Ночи
    local clock = Lighting.ClockTime
    local shouldBeNight = (clock >= 18 or clock < 6)
    
    if shouldBeNight ~= isNight then
        isNight = shouldBeNight
        if isNight then currentState = "Night"; ApplyProfile(NightProfile, 7) 
        else currentState = "Day"; ApplyProfile(DayProfile, 7) end
    end
    
    if currentState == "Night" then
        Atmos.Density = NightProfile.Atmos.Density + math.sin(timeAccum * 0.8) * 0.02
        local shake = math.sin(timeAccum * 2) * 0.015
        Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(shake, shake, 0)
    elseif currentState == "Day" then
        SunRays.Intensity = DayProfile.SunRays.Intensity + math.sin(timeAccum * 2) * 0.15
        Bloom.Intensity = DayProfile.Bloom.Intensity + math.cos(timeAccum * 1.5) * 0.5
    end
end)

print("[MEGA SYSTEM] v6.3 Loaded. No Puddles. Pure Atmosphere.")
